name: EU/EEA/Swiss Right of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens may reside in Finland freely for up to 3 months without any registration.

Staying longer than 3 months continuously requires registering the right of residence, on grounds of employment/self-employment, studies, family ties to an EU citizen, or sufficient funds not requiring social assistance. The 3-month clock restarts on re-entry after travel abroad.
requirements.fix_path: Register the right of residence with the Finnish Immigration Service.

evidence_required.document: Valid EU/EEA/Swiss ID card or passport
Proof of employment, self-employment, sufficient funds, or student status (for registration beyond 3 months)

outcome.duration_length: registration is valid until further notice, subject to continuing to meet the grounds

sources.title: Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Registering an EU Citizen's Right of Residence: 3-month free-residence period, registration grounds (employment, studies, family, sufficient funds)
Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Right of Permanent Residence of EU Citizens: 5 continuous years of legal residence, permitted-absence rules, EUR 53 fee

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). pr_after_months (60) reflects the EU-specific 'right of permanent residence' (5 years), which is a separate, EU-citizen-only status from the general fi_permanent_residence.json P-permit track that non-EU nationals use (which itself was overhauled by 5 new paths effective 8 January 2026 -- see that file). citizenship_after_months (96) uses fi_naturalisation.json's standard 8-year bar as the conservative default; a reduced 5-year path exists for applicants who meet the language-proficiency requirement (see fi_naturalisation.json), not modeled here as guaranteed.
